text:
Carla M: quick heads-up — we're aiming to publish the cloud marketplace listings this week. need final brand assets and contracting signoff.
Brian K: I can pull the hero image + screenshots from the marketing bucket. Which sizes required for AWS vs GCP?
Carla M: AWS needs 1280x720 hero + 512x512 icon. GCP prefers 1024x512 but will accept 1280x720. Azure wants 1024x768 hero. I'll add a doc.
Alice L: Legal reviewing T&Cs now. quick Q: any third-party logos included in screenshots? we need rights confirmed.
Brian K: a couple partner logos in the demo screenshot — will remove if legal flags it. pinging @Legal Liaison for final ok :pray: 
Legal Liaison: reviewing. If logos are present we'll need written permission or blur them. also checking trial license wording for marketplace billing.
Marketplace Bot: listing-staging created: id=mlstg-20260323-09, status=assets_missing
DevOps Sam: FYI for deploy runbook: staging provisioning uses the publisher IAM role, then run `./deploy_publish.sh --staging --validate` — include step to rotate the API key.
Carla M: good. Can someone do a dry run tomorrow at 10am PT? want to catch packaging artifacts & eula flows.
Brian K: I can do the dry run, bring the screenshots and packaging zip. where should I upload the package? storage.redwood/marketplace/drops
DevOps Sam: upload to that path and also add a checksum file. run `sha256sum artifacts.zip > artifacts.zip.sha256`
Alice L: once legal signs off I'll attach the approved EULA doc to the listing. expecting signoff by EOD.
Carla M: perfect. recap: Brian -> prepare assets + package, Sam -> run deploy script & validate, Alice/Legal -> sign EULA. meet at 10am PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Marketplace Bot: reminder scheduled: dry-run at 2026-03-24T17:00Z
Carla M: thanks all — tagging partners@ for awareness.
